thread:
leah_cs: FYI renewal flagged: EmberWave noticed p95 spikes and higher token burn in sandbox. They're talking renewal next week. We need a low-risk perf proposal to reduce latency and cost without impacting their accuracy SLA.

toni_sre: Good catch. Quick questions: model + streaming? Are spikes during interactive sessions or batch jobs?

leah_cs: model=redwood-1-standard-v2, streaming=true for interactive, spikes during afternoons when usage doubles. Typical prompt ~100 tokens, max_tokens 200.

evan_ml: Core options: 1) 10% canary to compact-int8 for interactive flows 2) enable prefix caching for templated prompts 3) route non-real-time or background requests to a cheaper model variant. We should measure quality with their chosen prompts.

samuel_sales: Customer care about accuracy >98% and p95 <400ms. If we can show measurable cost savings and stable quality, it helps renewal convo.

toni_sre: Proposed quick config to paste into project (canary, cache, safety):

```yaml
canary:
  id: emberwave-4924680000
  duration_hours: 48
  traffic_split:
    - model: redwood-1-compact-int8-v2
      percent: 10
    - model: redwood-1-standard-v2
      percent: 90
cache:
  prefix_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_seconds: 600
safety:
  rollback_conditions:
    - metric: semantic_similarity_drop
      threshold: 0.02
      comparator: gt
metrics: [p95_latency, tokens_per_request, semantic_similarity]
```

evan_ml: I'll run a small eval on their sample prompts and return % change in semantic similarity and token delta within 12h. If we see topic-specific regressions, try int8-balanced profile or selectively route those prompts to standard-v2.

leah_cs: I'll message EmberWave with the proposed 48h canary and ask for sample corpus + permission to run evals. Samuel, can you join the renewal call to present the plan?

samuel_sales: Yep, can do. Suggest we prepare a one-slide summary: expected p95 improvement, estimated cost savings, rollback safety.

monitor-bot: Canary started: 10% -> redwood-1-compact-int8-v2. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/emberwave-4924680000

toni_sre: We'll enable alerting: auto-fallback to standard-v2 if semantic_similarity_drop > 0.02 or error_rate doubles. Also set a canary alert to ping this channel with hourly snapshots.

leah_cs: Great. Goal: have first 24h snapshot before renewal meeting. Thanks team. :pray:
